title: Make project state portable across machines and agent setups
description: Issues, memories and agent instructions are all local-only today. Switch bd to JSONL/no-db mode so issues travel in git, move portable memories into the repo AGENTS.md, consolidate the user-level CLAUDE.md into the repo, and de-Windows the committed .claude/settings.json.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh clone on another machine yields the same issue list, the same project knowledge, and agent instructions that load in both Claude and non-Claude setups.

title: Add UHealthComponent in C++
description: First gameplay system. A UActorComponent holding current/max health, a damage handler wired to UE's TakeDamage pipeline, and a death multicast delegate so other actors can react. Expose MaxHealth as EditAnywhere/BlueprintReadWrite so it is tunable per-Blueprint without recompiling.
acceptance_criteria: Component compiles; can be added to any Actor in editor; MaxHealth editable in details panel; OnDeath delegate fires exactly once when health reaches zero.

title: Decide how C++ classes attach to the template Blueprints
description: The template gameplay (BP_FirstPersonCharacter, weapon, game mode) is pure Blueprint. Two ways to introduce C++: reparent the existing BPs to new C++ base classes, or just add C++ components to them in the editor. Reparenting gives a cleaner long term architecture but can be fiddly on template BPs; adding components is one click and non-destructive. Pick one deliberately rather than drifting into a mix.
acceptance_criteria: A decision is recorded and applied consistently to at least the character.

title: Add shootable target actor to validate damage pipeline
description: A simple AActor with a static mesh and a UHealthComponent that can be shot with the template pistol. Gives a visible end-to-end test that weapon trace -> damage -> health -> death actually works, before any of it is built on.
acceptance_criteria: Target placed in Lvl_IntroRoom takes damage from the existing first person weapon and is destroyed or visibly reacts on death.

title: Back up beads issue database off-machine
description: The Dolt database in .beads/ is gitignored, so issue history is local-only and dies with the disk. Deferred deliberately on 2026-09-16 since this is a learning project. Revisit if the issue list starts carrying real planning weight. Options: 'bd backup export-git' (JSONL snapshot on a beads-backup branch of the existing GitHub repo, no new accounts) or a DoltHub remote via 'bd dolt remote add'.
close_reason: Superseded: issues now sync via git-tracked .beads/issues.jsonl (bd export/import), which covers off-machine recovery without a Dolt remote or DoltHub account.

title: Narrow the broad *.db gitignore pattern added by bd init
description: bd init appended a bare '*.db' rule to the root .gitignore, which will silently ignore any future game data file ending in .db anywhere in the repo, not just Dolt state. Scope it to the .beads/ and .dolt/ directories instead.
acceptance_criteria: *.db is scoped to beads/dolt paths; no unrelated file is silently ignored.
